**Sources (required for numerical changes)**
Cite the published agronomy source for any change to species.json or crop-systems.json. Wikipedia and unsourced web pages are not accepted as primary sources.

**Checklist**
- [ ] No new external runtime dependencies added (this repo stays vanilla JS).
- [ ] If data files changed, the source is cited in docs/data-sources.md.
- [ ] If a new species or crop system is added, docs/species-reference.md is updated.
